subject: Reasoning
description: Alphabet-position patterns, skip patterns, missing letters

questions.stem: Find the next letter in the series: A, C, E, G, __?
questions.explanation: Skip one letter each time — A (skip B) C (skip D) E (skip F) G (skip H) → I. All odd-position letters of the alphabet: A(1), C(3), E(5), G(7), I(9). Shortcut: position number = 2n − 1 for n = 1, 2, 3, 4, 5.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: Find the next pair: AB, DE, GH, __?
questions.explanation: Each pair skips one letter after the previous pair. AB → skip C → DE → skip F → GH → skip I → JK. Positions: A(1)B(2) → D(4)E(5) → G(7)H(8) → J(10)K(11). Gap between first-letters is 3 each time.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: Find the missing letter: B, D, F, __, J, L.
questions.explanation: Even-position letters of the alphabet — B(2), D(4), F(6), H(8), J(10), L(12). Gap of +2 each time. The missing letter at position 8 is H. Verify the rest: J(10)-H(8)=2 ✓; L(12)-J(10)=2 ✓.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: Find the next letter: Z, X, V, T, __?
questions.explanation: Descending, gap of −2. Z(26) → X(24) → V(22) → T(20) → R(18). The even-position letters going backwards from Z. Shortcut: 'alphabet − position' — every other letter from the end.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: Find the next term: AZ, BY, CX, __?
questions.explanation: Two-letter pattern — 1st letters go forward (A, B, C, D, …), 2nd letters go backward (Z, Y, X, W, …). Each position sums to 27 (A+Z=1+26=27, B+Y=2+25=27, C+X=3+24=27, D+W=4+23=27). Also known as 'complementary alphabet' pairs.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: If every letter of the word COMPUTER is shifted 2 positions forward in the alphabet, the new word is:
questions.explanation: Shift each letter +2: C(3)→E(5), O(15)→Q(17), M(13)→O(15), P(16)→R(18), U(21)→W(23), T(20)→V(22), E(5)→G(7), R(18)→T(20). Result: EQORWVGT. Trap DPNQVUFS is shift +1 (off by one).
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: Find the next term: AB2, CD4, EF6, __?
questions.explanation: Letters — AB, CD, EF, GH (consecutive pairs). Numbers — 2, 4, 6, 8 (arithmetic progression +2). So next = GH8. The letter-pair formula is 'next consecutive pair of letters'; the number formula is 'add 2 to the previous number'.
